cpu_and_load_for_eval_evidence.load_for_eval_assessment: It reconstructs the same GPT, strictly loads the trained model state, freezes it in eval mode, and only extends deterministic nonpersistent rotary buffers for evaluation context length. It does not substitute a different trained model.
cpu_and_load_for_eval_evidence.local_rerun_limitation: The controller's /usr/bin Python lacked torch, so tensor CPU checks were not recomputed during this review. Static suites were rerun, preserved CPU results were inspected, exact candidate-byte identity was proved, and the same bytes subsequently completed two full-chip runs.

control_limitations.reason: Moving exact, twice-run bytes to root does not itself require another control.
requirements_for_new_causal_arms: Every new arm still needs a completed proposal and a predeclared comparable control under the experiment protocol.
The recent trn21 confirmation can serve as the control only for a nearby trn21 comparison with identical relevant source, environment and runtime fingerprints.
A trn22 arm requires a fresh same-host canonical MATRIX_LR 0.015 control before claiming a win.
A materially delayed or runtime-changed cohort requires a fresh same-host control.
Cross-host BPB or step-rate differences must not be treated as causal.

postflight_assessment: The recorded postflight false state was caused only by less than 8 GiB free disk after successful runs. Device holders and Neuron processes were absent, checkpoints were finite and preserved, evaluations and sealed artifact audits succeeded. This does not invalidate the completed scientific evidence, but a subsequent run must independently pass a fresh preflight disk gate.
authorized_use: Pinned research base for future separately proposed and approved experiments.
